Product Engineer – Electrical 
 
 As a Product Engineer, you will interface with customers, vendors, quality assurance, management, safety, production, and test personnel.  You'll manage special projects for customer specific needs.  Generate production procedures, test procedures, reports, and product memorandums.  Oversee production of products and manage resources to meet customer schedule. 
 
 Location: Middleburgh Heights, OH (greater Cleveland area)
 
 Salary: $85,000 - $90,000 
 Please note that the salary range information provided is a general guideline only.. Criteria such as the candidate’s qualifications and relevant experience, the scope of the specific position, as well as market and business considerations will be evaluated when extending an offer. 
 
 We Take Care of Our People 
 Paid Time Off I 401K with Employer Match and Profit Sharing I Health and Wellness Benefits I Learning and Development Opportunities I Referral Program I Competitive Pay I Recognition I Employee Stock Purchase Plan   I Inclusive & Supportive Culture 
 
 Your Challenge: 
 Ability to accurately review and approve customer purchase orders and specifications.

 Ability to generate work orders, engineering change orders and specifications  

 Generate/revise production drawings and create bills of material in ERP system.

 Verify component parts are in stock. Coordinate with purchasing department to procure needed parts. 

 Assist other personnel as required. Assist as needed with inventory and production needs.

 Assist in the setting up of electrical test equipment.

 Maintain a neat and clean work area.

 Curtiss-Wright – Middleburg Heights, is a global supplier of fluid sealing services and technologies, safety-related fasteners, commercial grade fasteners, precision-machined components and electrical interconnections for the power generation industry. Curtiss-Wright – Middleburg Heights provides next-generation technology, equipment, services and experience, and we stand ready to support our industry’s complex and evolving requirements.
